treatment_description: Zero tillage (ZT), direct seeding with zero-till ferti-cum-seed drill, rice residues retained on surface
notes: Treatment mean (40.08 q/ha) explicitly stated in text. Control mean (~34 q/ha) estimated from Figure 1 bar chart. SE values (~3 q/ha each) estimated from figure error bars with low precision. Paper has T1/T2 label inconsistency: methodology defines T1=ZT and T2=CT, but weed density/biomass data in Table 1 show T2 with lower weed counts, which the text attributes to zero tillage. However, the yield text unambiguously states 'Zero tillage produced a maximum yield of 40.08 q/ha' matching T1 as the taller bar in Figure 1. Number of replications not stated (likely 3 based on typical Indian agricultural experimental designs). LSD used for mean comparisons (P=0.05) but LSD value for yield not reported. The positive effect (+17.9%) for no-till contradicts the expected negative direction but is consistent with rice-wheat systems in the Indo-Gangetic Plains where ZT with residue retention often increases wheat yield. Single-season study (2021-22). Weed management was a subplot factor with 9 levels; yield data reported only as tillage main-effect means averaged across weed management practices.
